text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabweans who are HIV positive and deliberately expose others to the infection will face a jail term of up to 15 years if proposals to change the law are accepted.
- The Harare City Council is owed almost Z$500 million in uncollected rates and other charges, 80 percent more than originally thought, investigations by consultants have established.

- Farmers and processors and buyers of agricultural produce will have to pay levies into an Agricultural Industry Fund which will use the money to promote research, production, marketing, demand, training and advisory services to improve the sector.
